noBranch: Select a school or branch to manage grading.

settings.title: Grading
settings.subtitle: Scales, letters and how report cards display marks.

policies.empty: No rules yet — every grade uses the numeric percentage scale.
policies.fallbackNote: Grades not covered by a rule use the platform percentage scale, shown as numbers.

continuousAssessment.title: Continuous assessments
continuousAssessment.subtitle: The assessment plan teachers' marklists follow — set by the principal or director.
continuousAssessment.name: Name
continuousAssessment.appliesToHint: Add a grade to target its sections and subjects. “All grades” covers the whole branch.
continuousAssessment.subject: Subject
continuousAssessment.weightHint: Weights must add up to exactly 100.
continuousAssessment.planLocked: Teachers receive these assessments automatically and cannot change them.
continuousAssessment.empty: No continuous assessments for this semester yet.
continuousAssessment.emptyHint: Without a continuous assessment plan, teachers define their own assessments (weights still capped at 100).

conflict.title: This plan overlaps existing assessments
conflict.intro: Some of these grades and subjects already have assessments. Choose how to continue — the change applies only where the plans overlap.
conflict.migrateHint: Recorded marks move onto the new assessment of the same type (quiz → quiz, mid exam → mid exam). Scores are rescaled when the maximum changes; marks with no matching type are deleted.
conflict.replaceHint: All overlapping assessments and every mark recorded on them are permanently deleted. Teachers start over from the new plan.
conflict.ackReplace: I have read the warning above and understand that marks recorded for the overlapping grades and subjects will be permanently deleted.
conflict.ackMigrate: I understand that recorded marks without a matching assessment type in the new plan will be permanently deleted.

marklists.title: Marklists
marklists.subtitle: Enter marks, then submit for approval.
marklists.subject: Subject

grid.weightedExplainer: The highlighted value beside each mark is its weighted score: mark ÷ maximum × weight. The semester total and report cards use weighted scores.
grid.freeForm: Free-form marklist — you define the assessments (weights up to 100).
grid.submitConfirmDesc: Marks lock after submission — a supervisor must reopen the marklist for further edits.
grid.approveConfirmDesc: Approval countersigns the marks. Report cards should only be printed from approved marklists.
grid.reopenConfirmDesc: The marklist returns to draft and marks become editable again.
grid.lockedBanner: This marklist is {status} — marks are read-only.
grid.closedTerm: This semester is closed — records are read-only.
grid.noStudents: No active students in this section.
grid.invalidTitle: {count} mark(s) can't be saved — fix them first
grid.invalidSticky: {count} mark(s) over the maximum — tap to fix
grid.assistReadOnly: This is {teacher}'s marklist — marks are read-only until you start entering on their behalf.
grid.assistExplain1: {teacher} is notified immediately, with your reason.
grid.assistExplain2: Every mark you enter is labeled with your name.
grid.assistExplain3: A different supervisor must approve this marklist — you cannot countersign your own entries.
grid.assistReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Teacher on sick leave this week
grid.assistStarted: On-behalf entry started — the teacher has been notified.
grid.submitConfirmAssisted: {count} mark(s) were entered by {names}. Submitting confirms every mark, including those.
grid.fourEyes: You entered marks on this marklist — a different supervisor must approve it.

reportCards.title: Report cards
reportCards.subtitle: Frozen semester results — ranks, letters, conduct and printing.
reportCards.empty: No computed results for this semester yet.
reportCards.emptyHint: Recompute to preview — results freeze automatically when the semester closes.
reportCards.notPublished: Results are not published for this semester yet.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.subtitle: Complete academic record from frozen semester results.
transcript.empty: No frozen results yet — the transcript fills in as semesters close.
transcript.qrTitle: Scan to open this transcript online
transcript.qrHint: The QR always shows the authoritative record — issued through Temari.et.
transcript.publicRevoked: This transcript has been revoked by the issuing school — it is no longer valid.
transcript.publicNotFound: This transcript link is not valid. Check the QR code and try again.

reports.title: Grading reports
reports.subtitle: Term performance at a glance — bands, subjects, sections and marklist progress.
reports.noData: No data for this selection yet.
reports.subjectHint: Average weighted total per subject, out of 100.
reports.sectionHint: Average and pass rate per section.
reports.marklistHint: How many marklists are approved, submitted or still drafts.
reports.topStudentsHint: Highest term averages in this scope.
reports.atRiskHint: Below the pass line, weakest first — worth a follow-up.
reports.allPassing: Every graded student in this scope is passing.

analysis.subject: Subject
analysis.rangesHint: Seeded from the grading scale — adjust, add or remove ranges freely.
analysis.distributionHint: Students per range, split by gender.

submissions.remindAllBody: Teachers behind on {count} marklists will get an in-app reminder listing their pending classes. Repeated reminders update the same notification.
submissions.empty: No teaching assignments in this scope.
submissions.remindNone: None of the selected classes need a reminder — they are approved, or the teacher has no account.

rosters.title: Rosters
rosters.subtitle: The classic roster sheets — every subject, total, average and rank from the frozen results.
rosters.selectGradeHint: Pick a grade (and optionally a section) to open its roster.
rosters.recomputeBody: Temari will read the marks teachers have entered for {term} so far and rebuild every student's subject totals, average and class rank. This replaces the numbers computed last time; subjects with no marks yet stay blank. Conduct marks and homeroom comments are kept.
rosters.empty: No frozen results for this selection yet.
rosters.emptyHint: Results freeze when the semester closes — or recompute a preview any time.
rosters.publicRevoked: This roster has been revoked by the issuing school.
rosters.publicNotFound: This roster could not be found.
rosters.incompleteMarklists: Results are incomplete: {count} marklists are not yet approved for this semester.

transcripts.title: Transcripts
transcripts.subtitle: Pick a class, review readiness, then print or export official transcripts in bulk.
transcripts.selectGradeHint: Pick an academic year and a grade (and optionally a section) to open the register.
transcripts.tooMany: Select at most {max} students per print batch.
transcripts.empty: No enrolled students for this selection.
transcripts.emptyHint: Check the year, grade and section filters.

side.insideHint: The subject grid, ranks and the skill checklist.
side.coverHint: The outer sheet: school cover page and the remarks page.
side.bothHint: Cover then marks for each student, ready for double-sided printing.

printCards.overCap: Print at most {max} students per batch — narrow the selection and run it again.

extras.title: Extra assessment
extras.closedTerm: This term is closed — its entries are read-only.
extras.noSkills: No skill checklist is configured. A school manager can add one under School settings → Report cards.
extras.legend: E = Excellent · VG = Very Good · S = Satisfactory · NI = Needs Improvement
